selection_basis: advance rounding budget plus one directional ULP margin: near endpoint, linear span/product/sum contribute at most approximately one physical ULP after small input displacement; log quotient/log/product errors are suppressed by the small input displacement, while exp and anchor multiplication can each contribute rounding; conditional root includes one parent-bound rounding. The respective 2/3/3 allowances are the smallest integers in this declared conservative budget and remain subject to independent reference verification before integration.

boundary_regime.input_rule: for the applicable bound, first-order physical displacement from the exact stored u must be no more than 8 adjacent float64 ULPs inward; the independent full Decimal reference must also lie no farther than 8 ULPs inward
boundary_regime.full_map_error_rule: absolute raw-to-full-reference error measured in physical-bound directional ULPs must not exceed the branch allowance
boundary_regime.natural_endpoint_rule: same input regime and full-reference checks as repaired overshoot
boundary_regime.repair_rule: apply min/max immediately after raw component calculation and before dependent conditional bounds; retain raw and diagnostics
boundary_regime.unit_saturation_rule: exact 0 or 1 rejects separately; no epsilon replacement
